Title: Pick CRM base (Twenty vs EspoCRM)
Description: One-week spike comparing Twenty CRM (TS/React/NestJS/Postgres) vs EspoCRM (PHP). Decision must be team-stack-aligned and forkable.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision document filed in Notion with pros/cons, fork strategy, custom-object capability, modern UX rating | Vanilla install of chosen CRM running on dev VPS, accessible to whole team | Recommendation signed off by lead engineer + product owner

Title: Submit WhatsApp Business Account + Meta verification
Description: Submit WABA application to Meta. Takes 2-4 weeks; blocks Phase 2 if delayed. Do this day 1.
Acceptance Criteria: WABA application submitted with correct business display name | Meta Business Manager configured | Cloud API access requested | Tracker for verification status with daily check

Title: Provision infra skeleton
Description: AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) + staging cluster · Postgres 16 · Redis · S3 · KMS secrets · OpenTelemetry to Grafana + Sentry · CI/CD on GitHub Actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Hello-world app deploys to staging via CI/CD | Postgres + Redis + S3 reachable from staging app | Sentry receives test errors. Grafana dashboard shows app health | Terraform code committed; cluster reproducible

Title: Domain plan + DNS + SSL
Description: app.haip.io (CRM), api.haip.io, wa.haip.io (WA webhook), book.haip.io (landing). LetsEncrypt or ACM.
Acceptance Criteria: All four resolve to staging cluster; HTTPS valid; redirects http to https

Title: Auth & SSO strategy
Description: Decision: Auth0 vs WorkOS vs custom (NextAuth + Postgres). SAML + OIDC + SCIM contemplated even if MVP ships email+password only.
Acceptance Criteria: ADR filed; password policy set (12+ chars MFA on for admin); audit log retention = 365 days

Title: Data model in Notion (review with Reservations Head)
Description: Draft the §7 hospitality data model with field types validations examples. Review line-by-line with reservations head + senior concierge.
Acceptance Criteria: Notion page covers all 14 entities (Guest Inquiry Conversation Message Villa Stay Rate Plan Experience Campaign Call Activity Property User Consent log) | Every field has type validation rule example value | Sign-off recorded from reservations head

Title: Inquiry lifecycle stages + source taxonomy
Description: Lock the stages (New > Responding > Quoted > Site-visit > Booked > Lost > Ghosted) and source enum (Website Google Meta IG Meta FB Click-to-WA WA Direct Email Phone Walk-in Referral Travel Agent).
Acceptance Criteria: Enums committed in enums.py; Lost-reason taxonomy drafted (8 categories)

Title: Pick channel manager (Hostaway vs Lodgify vs Guesty)
Description: Confirm webhook + API capability sandbox access INR billing. Sign contract.
Acceptance Criteria: Sandbox creds in vault; Hello world booking event reaches our staging webhook

Title: Pick telephony provider (Exotel vs Knowlarity)
Description: Confirm recording + masking + CRM webhook + API. Provision a test number. Verify webhook in sandbox.
Acceptance Criteria: Test number rings then webhook fires then JSON payload schema captured

Title: Audit last 30 days of inbound inquiries
Description: Read 30 days of WA, IG, web-form, call, email inquiries from existing tools. Feeds dedup rules + source taxonomy + glossary for AI Concierge.
Acceptance Criteria: Sheet with 200+ rows: channel, contact, message excerpt, source, occasion, outcome

Title: Brand voice guide v1
Description: Tone vocabulary examples of good and bad replies. The AI Concierge agent is only as good as this document.
Acceptance Criteria: 5+ pages in Notion; 10+ good examples; 10+ bad examples; signed off by owner

Title: Call QA rubric v1
Description: Use even before QA agent ships - north star for good.
Acceptance Criteria: 12 criteria with weights scoring method (yes-no / 0-3 / auto-fail) evidence requirement

Title: Spin up n8n
Description: Self-hosted behind VPN for non-critical glue (Slack pings Notion sync Sheets exports).
Acceptance Criteria: n8n reachable from internal network; Hello Slack workflow runs

Title: Hosting region + DPDP/GDPR posture
Description: ap-south-1 default for India tenants; ap-southeast-1 for SEA; eu-central-1 for EU. Per-tenant residency flag in Tenant row.
Acceptance Criteria: ADR filed; data-flow diagram covers cross-region

Title: Postgres schema migrations (entities)
Description: Implement the 14 entities with relationships from §7 of PRD. Use alembic migrations.
Acceptance Criteria: Tables created with correct PK/FK; phone is E.164 unique on Guest | Soft-delete supported on Guest User; audit-log triggers active | 100% migration up/down clean on local + staging

Title: Custom field validation
Description: Server-side: check_out > check_in, phone E.164, occupancy <= villa max, no double-booked dates per villa.
Acceptance Criteria: Pydantic models reject violations; integration tests cover all 4 rules

Title: Phone-based dedup engine
Description: Channel handlers must perform E.164 phone-based upsert before creating any record. Email = secondary identifier; cookie/UTM = metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: dedup_guest(phone email?) function; covers 5 edge cases (whitespace country code variants fake/test numbers formatting) | 50-row regression test from T1.10 audit

Title: pgvector setup + embedding store
Description: Single Postgres for relational + vector. Per-tenant + per-namespace schema.
Acceptance Criteria: embeddings table exists; sample insert + cosine search returns expected docs

Title: Tenant model + multi-tenant data isolation
Description: Every row carries tenant_id; row-level security policies in Postgres; per-tenant KMS key.
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-tenant query in test suite returns zero rows even with admin token of wrong tenant

Title: Consent log table (append-only)
Description: Required for DPDP / GDPR + Meta WA policy.
Acceptance Criteria: consent_log is append-only (trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE); audit ID + IP + source captured

Title: User roles + permissions
Description: Roles: Owner, GM, Manager, Concierge, Reservations, Front-of-house, Marketing, Compliance, Read-only.
Acceptance Criteria: Permission matrix tested per role; concierge cannot edit rate plans etc

Title: Villa-level access control (ABAC)
Description: A concierge for Villa A only sees Villa A inquiries.
Acceptance Criteria: Concierge with villa_scope=[A] cannot fetch Villa B inquiries via API or UI

Title: SSO scaffolding (Google + Microsoft + Okta)
Description: OAuth2/OIDC flows; SCIM provisioning placeholder.
Acceptance Criteria: Login via Google works on staging; provisioning maps to internal User row

Title: Audit log (append-only) for all writes
Description: Capture who/what/when/before/after for Stay Rate Plan Inquiry status override etc.
Acceptance Criteria: Tampering attempt fails; 6-month retention enforced

Title: JWT + refresh-token flow + session mgmt
Description: 15-min access 30-day refresh revoke on password change.
Acceptance Criteria: Token revoked on logout; brute-force lockout after 10 attempts

Title: Inquiry kanban view
Description: Columns are lifecycle stages; cards show key fields; drag-to-progress; optimistic updates.
Acceptance Criteria: <1.2s load with 500 inquiries; drag triggers stage transition + activity creation

Title: Inquiry detail page
Description: Left: profile + conversation thread. Right: editable fields quote builder entry action buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: Field edits autosave + audit-log; thread shows last 50 messages with channel icons

Title: Villa availability calendar
Description: Villa x Date grid. Color codes: free / inquiry / quoted / booked / blocked / owner-use / maintenance.
Acceptance Criteria: 90-day window renders <1.5s with 50 villas; click cell then mini-quote popover

Title: Today's arrivals & departures
Description: For front-of-house staff. Mobile-friendly.
Acceptance Criteria: Special requests, transfer times, dietary surfaced inline; print-friendly view

Title: Guest 360 page
Description: Single view: profile, all inquiries, all stays, all conversations, lifetime value, preferences, VIP tier.
Acceptance Criteria: Loads <1.5s for guest with 12 stays; consent flags visible; merge-duplicate-guests action available to admin

Title: Unified Inbox UI (channel-agnostic)
Description: Three-pane conversation cockpit - list / thread / intelligence rail. Same shape on voice + chat.
Acceptance Criteria: WhatsApp + voice + email + IG render in single thread; AI rail shows live sentiment + intents + NBA

Title: Quote builder
Description: Pulls villa dates rate plan experiences; outputs branded PDF + WhatsApp template.
Acceptance Criteria: PDF render <3s; WA template substitutes correctly; activity logged on Inquiry

Title: Multi-language UI (Hindi + English)
Description: i18n via next-intl. RTL stub for Arabic (V1).
Acceptance Criteria: All inbox strings translate; date/number formatting per locale

Title: Lifecycle stage transition events
Description: Stage transitions emit events on internal bus. Quoted to Booked unlocks confirmation flow; New to Responding starts SLA.
Acceptance Criteria: 10 transition events fire correctly; idempotent on replay

Title: Routing rules engine
Description: By channel, language, occasion, agent availability, villa scope. Configurable in admin UI.
Acceptance Criteria: Rule editor saves; 20 routing test cases pass; rules versioned

Title: SLA timers + breach alerts
Description: Per-channel default SLA; per-tenant override. Breach to Slack + in-CRM banner.
Acceptance Criteria: 90-second SLA test breach fires Slack; banner clears on action; SLA stat surfaces in reports

Title: Activity / task auto-creation on transitions
Description: Follow up in 24h if no reply type tasks. Snoozable. Reassignable.
Acceptance Criteria: 8 task templates seed; assignee notification sent; mark-done updates CRM

Title: Pre-arrival sequences (foundation)
Description: Schedule events for +14 / +7 / +1 day pre-arrival. Worker fires on schedule. Used by AI Concierge in V1.5.
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduling persists across worker restart; manual cancel works

Title: REST API for core entities
Description: CRUD + list with pagination/filter/sort for Guest, Inquiry, Conversation, Message, Stay, Villa, Campaign.
Acceptance Criteria: OpenAPI spec generated; 90% endpoint test coverage; rate-limited per tenant

Title: GraphQL API (read-heavy)
Description: Optional layer for FE; resolvers atop the same service layer.
Acceptance Criteria: N+1 protected (DataLoader); auth + RBAC enforced; Apollo introspection on staging

Title: Inbound webhook endpoints (one per channel)
Description: /wh/wa, /wh/ig, /wh/voice/exotel, /wh/voice/twilio, /wh/cm/hostaway, /wh/leads/google, /wh/leads/meta. Signed payload verification.
Acceptance Criteria: 10 sample payloads per channel parse; bad signatures rejected with 401; request hash logged

Title: Internal event bus (Redis Streams)
Description: Events: inquiry.created, inquiry.stage_changed, conversation.message_received, stay.created, stay.cancelled, score.computed, override.applied.
Acceptance Criteria: At-least-once delivery; idempotency keys; consumer-group rebalance survives restart

Title: Webhook record/replay tool
Description: Replay missed events from raw store on demand. Admin UI.
Acceptance Criteria: Last 30 days searchable; replay marks event with replayed=true

Title: IVR webhook receiver (Exotel + Twilio)
Description: Endpoint receives call-completed events; verifies signature; queues a CallIngest job.
Acceptance Criteria: 95th-pct webhook to queue <300ms; bad-signature rejected; idempotent on retry

Title: Call record creation + Guest/Inquiry linking
Description: Create Call record. Link to Guest by phone (T2.3 dedup). Create new Inquiry if none open.
Acceptance Criteria: 100 test calls produce 100 Call rows + correct Guest/Inquiry links; 0 orphans

Title: Recording fetch + S3 storage with KMS
Description: Fetch from Exotel/Twilio; write to S3 with per-tenant KMS key; signed URL on read.
Acceptance Criteria: 10 sample recordings end-to-end; URLs expire in 1h; tenant-isolation verified

Title: PII redaction at L1 (pre-storage)
Description: Redact card numbers, Aadhaar, PAN, emails, phones in transcript text post-ASR. Replace with reversible tokens in tenant vault.
Acceptance Criteria: 4 redaction patterns regression-tested; raw text never leaves L1 to L2 unredacted

Title: Transcription pipeline · Deepgram (production)
Description: Async job; Deepgram Nova-2 with diarization; speaker labels mapped to agent vs guest using inbound number metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: 95th-pct transcript <60s after call end | WER <=12% on internal eval set (Hindi+English+Hinglish 100 samples) | Speaker diarization accuracy >90% on test set

Title: Whisper self-hosted fallback
Description: vLLM or whisper.cpp on GPU pool; switches in if Deepgram down or per-tenant cost cap reached.
Acceptance Criteria: Failover within 30s on simulated Deepgram outage; quality regression report committed

Title: Language detect + code-mixed handling
Description: fastText langid; sentence-level switching for code-mix.
Acceptance Criteria: 96% accuracy on 200-sample multilingual test; UI badge shows detected lang(s)

Title: Transcript storage + searchability
Description: Store JSON (turns + timestamps + speaker) on Postgres; embed for semantic search; full-text index for keyword.
Acceptance Criteria: Search refund returns relevant calls in <1s on 10K-call corpus

Title: Live transcript stream (V1.5 hook)
Description: WebSocket stub over Centrifugo so the inbox AI rail can subscribe. Real streaming in V1.5.
Acceptance Criteria: WS endpoint accepts subscribe; broadcasts on transcript-segment-ready; stream lag target documented

Title: Cost tracking per call
Description: Capture Deepgram + LLM + storage cost per call; aggregate per tenant per day.
Acceptance Criteria: Cost dashboard shows per-tenant spend; alert if conversation cost > Rs 10

Title: Rubric data model + editor (no-code)
Description: Customer creates/edits rubric: criteria weights scoring method (yes-no / 0-3 / auto-fail) evidence requirement.
Acceptance Criteria: Default 12-criterion rubric ships; clone + edit + version-control works; rubric snapshot is captured in every Score record

Title: LLM judge service (Claude Sonnet)
Description: Sonnet with structured-output JSON schema; chain-of-thought hidden; rejection sample on schema fail.
Acceptance Criteria: 100% of Calls scored within 90s of transcript-ready | Schema-fail rate <0.5% | Per-criterion confidence + evidence span returned on every output

Title: Multi-model routing + cost cap
Description: Haiku for cheap classification Sonnet for live judge Opus for ambiguous overrides only. Cache by conv-hash + rubric-hash.
Acceptance Criteria: Cache hit-rate >40% after 1 week; per-tenant cap enforced

Title: Evidence linking (transcript span + audio timestamp)
Description: Each criterion score links to a transcript range and audio timestamp; UI highlight + seek.
Acceptance Criteria: 95%+ scores have valid evidence span; click then seek in audio works

Title: Override workflow
Description: Analyst override per criterion; reason captured; audit-logged; feeds tenant fine-tune (opt-in).
Acceptance Criteria: Override flow is one-click; before/after captured; agreement-rate dashboard updates

Title: Eval harness (CI gate)
Description: 50-100 real-call transcripts with ideal scores. Run on every prompt change. #1 reason AI agents quietly degrade.
Acceptance Criteria: CI fails when agreement <85% on eval set; per-criterion regression report posted to PR

Title: Drift monitor (production)
Description: Daily AI-vs-sampled-human comparison; auto-pause automation if agreement drops below tenant threshold.
Acceptance Criteria: Monitor visible on workspace dashboard; auto-pause tested on simulated drift; Slack alert fires

Title: Per-concierge weekly report
Description: Score, trend, top 3 strengths, top 3 gaps, two sample calls (best + worst) with timestamps. Auto-email on Mondays.
Acceptance Criteria: Sample report renders correctly for 5 concierges; opt-out flag honoured

Title: Insights dashboard (Owner, Reservations, QA)
Description: KPIs: avg score, override rate, auto-fail rate, coaching lift. Funnel, channel mix, theme summary.
Acceptance Criteria: Loads <1.5s on 10K-call corpus; 7d/30d/QTD filters; drill from KPI to underlying call list

Title: Agent leaderboard + skill matrix
Description: Per-criterion radar per concierge; team ranking with confidence intervals.
Acceptance Criteria: 4-week trend renders; click cell then list of contributing calls

Title: Theme clustering (lost-reason + objection)
Description: HDBSCAN on transcript embeddings; LLM labels each cluster.
Acceptance Criteria: Top 10 themes weekly; coverage >60% of conversations; manual rename + merge supported
